/* Page navigation follows the Studio accent even before hover or focus. */
.desk-back,.agent-back,[data-page-back]{color:var(--ecco-theme-accent,var(--accent,#ffdc24))!important}
.desk-back:focus-visible,.agent-back:focus-visible,[data-page-back]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ecco-theme-accent,var(--accent,#ffdc24));outline-offset:2px}

/* Ecco identity on the original Desk design. */
.ecco-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;color:inherit}
.ecco-logo{display:block;width:46px;height:46px;object-fit:contain;flex:none}
.ecco-wordmark{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.4px;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.3}
.ecco-wordmark small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.sidebar .ecco-wordmark small{color:#8da1ad}
@media(max-width:1150px){.sidebar .ecco-logo{width:38px;height:38px}.sidebar .ecco-wordmark{font-size:18px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.sidebar .ecco-logo{width:46px;height:46px}.sidebar .ecco-wordmark{font-size:20px}}

/* Keep history-first categories and circled creation in the original palette. */
.notification-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:0 8px;min-width:0}
.notification-tabs [role=tab]{min-width:0;padding:12px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;background:#f0f3f4;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;position:relative;top:1px}
.notification-tabs [role=tab][aria-selected=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border-bottom:1px solid #fff}
.notification-tabs [role=tab]:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.user-notifications{gap:0}.user-notifications>[role=tabpanel]{min-width:0}.user-notifications>[role=tabpanel]>.ticket-section{border-top:0;border-top-left-radius:0;border-top-right-radius:0}

.notification-create:hover{filter:brightness(.96)}
.notification-create:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #1a8a79;outline-offset:3px}

.notification-history summary{font-size:12px}.notification-history details p{font-size:11px}
